rows.grounds: compound; first member of the following compound describing Narasimha
compound adjective qualifying nṛ+siṃhaṃ; agent of destruction of the enemy host
object of smaret from the preceding verse; the deity Narasimha to be visualized
instrumental plural indicating substances used in worship or offering

items.question: By what destructive attribute and ritual substances is Narasimha to be visualized in this practice?
premises: The preceding context instructs one to remember Narasimha vividly.
Narasimha is characterized as causing the destruction of the enemy host.
Sandalwood and similar substances are associated with this visualization or worship.
items.inference: The practitioner should visualize Narasimha as the destroyer of enemy hosts while employing sandalwood and other such ritual substances.
uncertainties: Whether candana+ādibhiḥ specifies offerings, anointing, or another ritual use is not explicit in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: One should visualize Narasimha, the destroyer of the host of enemies, with sandalwood and other such substances.
